278817763.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot
10 Piece Collection
Pyrite, Amethyst, Quartz, and Citrine
6" x 2" x 2" Packed Size
Unsigned Natural Specimens
This versatile mineral collection features ten distinct specimens showcasing a variety of geological formations and finishes. The lot contains striking Iron Pyrite (Fool's Gold) clusters, known for their brilliant metallic luster. The set is balanced with raw crystalline points and polished stones, including a banded amethyst sphere and a translucent tumbled citrine-style quartz specimen.
Includes a 20mm polished amethyst sphere with visible chevron banding
Four varied Iron Pyrite specimens displaying classic brass-yellow metallic sheen
Selection of raw clear and rose quartz points alongside a polished triangular stone
Specimens vary in size from approximately 0.5 to 1.5 inches in length
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. Raw specimens feature natural terminations and matrix. Polished stones exhibit a smooth finish with high surface gloss.

278601320.description: This listing includes two vintage-style quartz mantel clocks. The first clock has a faceted, octagonal clear crystal body with a gold-tone clock face featuring black Roman numerals and ornate decorative details on the dial. The second clock is a Seiko Quartz model QZ071G, made in Japan, with a rectangular case, gold-tone metal columns and top/bottom, and clear acrylic or glass sides. The Seiko clock has a white face with black Roman numerals and a visible clock mechanism on the back, showing some dust and wear. Both clocks are used; the Seiko clock has some tarnishing and scratches, while the crystal clock is in good visual condition. These timepieces are suitable as decorative desk or mantel clocks. The Seiko clock is ~7in tall, it has a small chip on the corner front right glass panel, the 2 small chipped pieces are loose in the clock. Sold as is.
